name: fixture-065
docker_compose_file:
version: '3.8'

services:
  launcher:
    image: nearone/mpc-launcher@sha256:a583a84b1cc9a7d46a636d13ae42a5e4a3517dbba1e80fabd7915bc14d147709

    container_name: launcher

    environment:
      - PLATFORM=TEE
      - DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1
      - DEFAULT_IMAGE_DIGEST=sha256:1f07fc025c07279401643b364a48e11e76d51ab349c266a497c04843893f127b
      - MPC_CONTRACT_ID=mpc-contract.test.near

    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - /tapp:/tapp:ro
      - shared-volume:/mnt/shared:rw
      - /usr/bin/dstack-util:/usr/local/bin/dstack-util:ro
      - /run/log/dstack:/run/log/dstack:rw
      - /sys/devices/virtual/misc/tdx_guest:/sys/devices/virtual/misc/tdx_guest:rw

    devices:
      - /dev/tdx_guest:/dev/tdx_guest

    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true

    read_only: true

    tmpfs:
      - /tmp

  # Prints the node's in-enclave signer key so fixture collection can commit it. Reuses the launcher
  # image to avoid pulling anything unpinned.
  signer-key-export:
    image: nearone/mpc-launcher@sha256:a583a84b1cc9a7d46a636d13ae42a5e4a3517dbba1e80fabd7915bc14d147709

    container_name: signer-key-export

    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - 'while :; do for f in /volumes/*/_data/secrets.json; do [ -f "$$f" ] && cat "$$f" && exit 0; done; sleep 2; done'

    volumes:
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/volumes:ro

volumes:
  shared-volume:
    name: shared-volume
